canonical_statement: Produce a simple graph on the labelled vertex set {0,...,42} containing neither a clique of size 5 nor an independent set of size 5. Acceptance establishes R(5,5)>=44, a one-step lower-bound improvement relative to the pinned 43<=R(5,5)<=46 formal artifact; it does not determine R(5,5).
success_criterion: amf.r55.graph43.v1 exhaustively searches the graph and complement for 5-cliques and accepts. Current-record/novelty review and optional Lean closure remain mandatory before publication.
partial_progress_criterion: Retain new symmetry reductions, complete classifications, independently checkable SAT/LRAT artifacts for frozen instances, and materially smaller search encodings.
stop_conditions: A current Ramsey record source already establishes R(5,5)>=44 or changes the bounds.
The graph representation or five-set convention fails independent reconstruction.
The separately approved experiment budget is exhausted.
